LOUVRE.gloss: one of a set of parallel slats in a door or window to admit air and reject rain
LOUVRE.definition: One of a set of parallel slats in a door or window to admit air and reject rain.

LOVER.gloss: a person who loves someone or is loved by someone
LOVER.definition: A person who loves someone or is loved by someone.

OVER.gloss: at or to a point across intervening space etc.
OVER.definition: At or to a point across intervening space etc.
OVER.example: Come over and see us some time.

LOVE.gloss: a strong positive emotion of regard and affection
LOVE.definition: A strong positive emotion of regard and affection.

ROLE.gloss: the actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group
ROLE.definition: The actions and activities assigned to or required or expected of a person or group.

RULE.gloss: a principle or condition that customarily governs behavior
RULE.definition: A principle or condition that customarily governs behavior.
RULE.example: It was his rule to take a walk before breakfast.

REV.gloss: increase the number of rotations per minute
REV.definition: Increase the number of rotations per minute.

ORE.definition: A mineral that contains metal that is valuable enough to be mined.

EURO.gloss: the basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union
EURO.definition: The basic monetary unit of most members of the European Union (introduced in 1999); in 2002 twelve European nations (Germany, France, Belgium, Luxembourg, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Ireland, Greece, Austria, Finland) adopted the euro as their basic unit of money and abandoned their traditional currencies.

LURE.gloss: qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward
LURE.definition: Qualities that attract by seeming to promise some kind of reward.

LORE.gloss: knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote
LORE.definition: Knowledge gained through tradition or anecdote.
LORE.example: Early peoples passed on plant and animal lore through legend.
